title: The coordinate projection pushes Hⁿ on an affine n-plane forward to Lebesgue measure
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let v = (v_0, …, v_{n−1}) be orthonormal in ℝ^P, w ∈ ℝ^P, Π := {y ∈ ℝ^P : y − w ∈ span(v)}, and let pL : ℝ^P → ℝⁿ be a continuous linear map with (pL x)_i = ⟨v_i, x⟩ for all x, i. Then the push-forward of Hⁿ⌞Π (Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P) under pL is Lebesgue measure on ℝⁿ: Measure.map pL (μHE[n].restrict Π) = volume on Euclid n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P) (w : Euclid P) (pL : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid n), Orthonormal ℝ v → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (i : Fin n), pL x i = inner ℝ (v i) x) → Measure.map pL ((μHE[n]).restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v)}) = (volume : Measure (Euclid n))
